title: Planning a bug that changes a function's verdict lists the suite assertions that pin the old verdict, and puts their test file in the touches
goal: precheck warns of a committed bug or story whose goal changes what a named function returns (a window, a verdict, a count) when a test file outside its touches calls that function, naming the file, so planning adds it (set ID --add-touch) or records why not before the start; in SP-vdrsfftl BG-vzsk2t5t's touches left out the live kb test file, whose two fixtures pinned the old window_sections fallback, so its worker stopped with a gate and had to be resumed with widened touches
